peg.peg_mechanism_score_basis: PegKeepers, LLAMMA lending/repayment and monetary policy support the dollar target. The rating measures the mechanism across stress, not a spot price. Zero current PegKeeper debt removes existing PK-issued burn capacity, not every peg-support mechanism.

backing.backing_score_basis: Collateral and exposure depend on issuance route: LLAMMA loans, YieldBasis borrowing, the Resupply lending operator and PegKeeper paired positions. Operator minting and actual borrowing are different. Deployed-basis coverage and a sensitivity counting idle minted allocation must remain separate; neither alone proves realizable collateral or insolvency.
backing.backing_score_persistence: filtered — 25% threshold over >5 consecutive daily readings

liquidity.liquidity_score_basis: Holders sell on secondary markets. Dollar-stablecoin routes differ from BTC/ETH routes, which require another trade to reach dollars. The historical rating uses routed USDC proceeds and total cost, not pool TVL or a price-impact field alone. Quotes are not fills.
liquidity.liquidity_score_persistence: filtered — venue structure, not spot depth
liquidity.liquidity_score_depth_caveat: November 2 10:36 UTC review: routed 2% total-impact crossing coarsely bracketed $10M-$25M. The last passing rung is not an exact maximum exit size. Source clocks, fees, gas and execution conditions remain separate.
liquidity.liquidity_score_ladder: Historical September 12 routed USDC quote costs before gas: $100k 2.7bp; $1M 3.3bp; $10M 16bp; $25M approximately 1,078bp; $50M approximately 4,345bp. These are dated quotes, not current executable offers.

dependencies.underlying_score_basis: YieldBasis creates material BTC/ETH rebalancing and supply concentration. At November 2 10:36 UTC, $98.833M recorded debt / $181.224M deployed-basis measure is 54.54%. Its attached WETH policy has a deployed 43% reserved-profit fraction. YieldBasis DAO configures it and its verifier; Curve emergency authority can kill and revive it. The verifier is upgradeable and owner-controlled; ultimate owner governance remains unresolved. These controls do not grant direct crvUSD mint authority.
dependencies.underlying_score_persistence: filtered — supply architecture, not a daily balance
dependencies.underlying_score_denominator: Dated deployed debt divided by deployed-basis supply; facility ceilings, raw ERC20 supply, pool token balances and collateral notionals are distinct measures. Complete current recipient enumeration is not established.

issuer.issuer_score_basis: Curve has a long operating history and publicly identified founder Michael Egorov, whose shared involvement with YieldBasis concentrates influence. Swiss Stake AG is a disclosed developer/grantee, not an established crvUSD repayment obligor. Token-specific legal recourse, entity registry details and a complete current financial review remain unresolved. Issuer 6.0 is carried from the historical assessment, not newly derived.
issuer.issuer_score_routing: Contract permissions and audit coverage belong to Contract & Admin; collateral concentration belongs to Dependencies and Backing. Issuer assesses accountability and governance conduct.

operating_refresh.note: YB deployed headline is market debt, not physical pool balances. Prior dated observations are historical.

scoped_review.scope: Accepted bounded authority/policy/issuance findings; historical score and financial observation clocks retained.
